body_html:
Most advice on this topic is vague. This guide is a field note: what to change on your site this week so you stand out for the right reasons.

Recruiters and clients don’t owe you a deep read. If the first screen is confusing, they leave.

This guide is for candidates designing for how recruiters actually read who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Smart portfolios feel calm: one idea per section, outcomes before tools, and a next step that doesn’t beg.

Do this next

  1. Above-the-fold clarity in five seconds
  2. Proof before personality essays
  3. Contact that works on mobile

Design for the skim

Assume ten seconds. If education, skills, and contact aren’t obvious, a busy recruiter won’t hunt. Pair a designed home with a Hire Me page that prints cleanly.

Taste without theatrics

Premium feels quiet: hierarchy, spacing, and one confident accent. If motion or dark themes fight readability, they cost you interviews.

How a website helps you stand out

Recruiters skim for risk reduction: clarity, credibility, and an easy next step. Design for that skim.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.com, create on dash.mybexo.com, share on yourname.atbexo.com. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Above-the-fold clarity in five seconds
  • Proof before personality essays
  • Contact that works on mobile

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
